en.name: XML to JSON Converter
en.description: Convert XML data to JSON format online. This XML to JSON converter lets you convert XML to JSON and transform XML documents into structured JSON objects, with customizable attribute handling, indentation, and text node options — all in your browser.

hero.trustHtml: 100% client-side conversion. Your data never leaves your browser.

meta.title: XML to JSON — Free Online Converter
meta.description: Convert XML to JSON format online. Transform XML documents into JSON objects with configurable attribute prefixes, indentation, and text handling. Free, fast, and 100% client-side. No upload required.

features.title: XML Import
features.description: Paste XML data directly or upload .xml files to convert. The tool supports common XML structures from APIs, configuration files, and legacy systems.

features.title: JSON Export
features.description: Download the converted JSON as a .json file or copy the output to your clipboard. Use the result in APIs, scripts, frontend applications, or other JSON-based workflows.

features.title: Customizable
features.description: Configure attribute prefix, text node handling, and JSON indentation (2 or 4 spaces). This helps match your project's conventions and downstream processing requirements.

features.title: Attribute Handling
features.description: XML attributes are converted to JSON properties with a customizable prefix (default: @) to distinguish them from child elements. This preserves attribute information in the JSON output.

features.title: Array Detection
features.description: Automatically detects repeated XML elements and groups them into JSON arrays. This makes the converted JSON more natural for programmatic use.

features.title: Private
features.description: All XML parsing and JSON conversion happen in your browser. Your data is not uploaded to a server, which is useful when working with private XML payloads or configuration data.

guide.title: Paste your XML
guide.description: Paste your XML document into the input field or upload a .xml file. You can use API responses, configuration files, or any XML structure you need to convert to JSON.

guide.title: Configure options
guide.description: Set the attribute prefix (default: @), choose whether to preserve #text nodes, and select JSON indentation (2 or 4 spaces). Adjust these to match your target system's expectations.

guide.title: Click Convert
guide.description: Click Convert to JSON to transform the XML into a JSON object. The tool preserves the structure, converts attributes, and detects arrays from repeated elements.

guide.title: Copy or Download
guide.description: Copy the JSON output to your clipboard or download it as a .json file. Use the result in frontend applications, APIs, data pipelines, or other JSON-based workflows.

example.useCase: Convert XML API responses to JSON for frontend processing.

faq.question: Is my XML data uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. All XML parsing and JSON conversion happen locally in your browser. Your data never leaves your device and is not stored or transmitted anywhere.

faq.question: How are XML attributes handled?
faq.answer: XML attributes are converted to JSON properties with a customizable prefix (default: @) to distinguish them from child elements. This preserves attribute information while keeping the JSON structure clear.

faq.question: Can I convert JSON back to XML?
faq.answer: Yes. Use a JSON to XML converter tool to transform JSON documents back into XML format. This is useful when moving data between JSON-based and XML-based systems.

faq.question: Does it support XML namespaces?
faq.answer: The converter handles basic XML structures well. Complex namespace handling may require specialized tools or post-processing, depending on your use case.

faq.question: Can I convert large XML files?
faq.answer: You can convert larger XML files as long as they can be loaded and processed by your browser. The practical limit depends on available memory, device performance, and the complexity of the XML structure.

faq.question: How are repeated XML elements handled?
faq.answer: When multiple elements share the same tag name, they are automatically grouped into a JSON array. This makes the converted JSON more natural for iteration and programmatic access.

faq.question: What does the Preserve #text option do?
faq.answer: When enabled, text content of elements is preserved with a #text key instead of being flattened. This can be useful when elements have both attributes and text content that need to be distinguished.

faq.question: Can I customize the attribute prefix?
faq.answer: Yes. You can set a custom prefix for XML attributes (default is @). This helps avoid naming conflicts and makes the JSON output match your project's conventions.

faq.question: Is this a free XML to JSON converter?
faq.answer: Yes. This is a free online XML to JSON converter. You can paste XML or upload files, configure options, and copy or download the JSON output without creating an account or uploading data to a server.

faq.question: 我的 XML 数据会上传到服务器吗？
faq.answer: 不会。所有 XML 解析和 JSON 转换都在浏览器本地完成，数据不会离开你的设备，也不会被存储或传输到任何地方。

faq.question: XML 属性怎么处理？
faq.answer: XML 属性会转换为带可自定义前缀（默认：@）的 JSON 属性，以区分子元素。这样可以在 JSON 输出中保留属性信息，同时保持结构清晰。

faq.question: 可以把 JSON 转回 XML 吗？
faq.answer: 可以。使用 JSON 转 XML 转换器工具可以将 JSON 文档转换回 XML 格式。这在需要在基于 JSON 和基于 XML 的系统之间移动数据时非常有用。

faq.question: 支持 XML 命名空间吗？
faq.answer: 转换器可以很好地处理基本的 XML 结构。复杂的命名空间处理可能需要专用工具或后处理，具体取决于你的使用场景。

faq.question: 可以转换大型 XML 文件吗？
faq.answer: 可以转换较大的 XML 文件，只要浏览器能够加载和处理它们。实际限制取决于设备性能、浏览器可用内存以及 XML 结构的复杂程度。

faq.question: 重复的 XML 元素怎么处理？
faq.answer: 当多个元素共享相同的标签名时，它们会自动分组为 JSON 数组。这使得转换后的 JSON 更适合迭代和程序化访问。

faq.question: “保留 #text”选项有什么作用？
faq.answer: 启用后，元素的文本内容会使用 #text 键保留，而不是被扁平化。当元素同时具有属性和文本内容且需要区分时，这个选项非常有用。

faq.question: 可以自定义属性前缀吗？
faq.answer: 可以。你可以为 XML 属性设置自定义前缀（默认是 @）。这有助于避免命名冲突，并使 JSON 输出符合项目的命名约定。

faq.question: 这是一个免费的 XML 转 JSON 转换器吗？
faq.answer: 是的。这是一个免费的在线 XML 转 JSON 转换器。你可以粘贴 XML 或上传文件，配置选项，并复制或下载 JSON 输出，无需创建账号或将数据上传到服务器。
